name: Ijippari Kanojo ~Kitaeteru Watashi ga, Konna SM Gokko de Ochiru Wake Nai Desho!?~
original_name: 意地っ張り彼女～鍛えてる私が、こんなＳＭごっこで堕ちるわけないでしょ！？～
source:
"I've been thinking about you and your work. You haven't been able to break your PB lately, have you?”

"You know, even if say that nobody sets new personal records when only the environment changes"

"what'd you say? If I listen to anything you say, I can set a new Personal record?"

I'm not sure what was to be expected, but I'll find a way with this new job. But one word completely turned on my motivation switch, and we practiced like crazy day in and day out to set a new personal record. Emi achieved a new personal record...

"You need to keep your promise now."

"All right, I got it... I'll keep your promise and fulfill it"

Emi was terribly embarrassed with her face turning red when regretfully declaring that she would fulfill her promise... So when will our next date be?

"I like doing this kind of thing, I want to have sex like this..."

"Umm, w-what is this SM..?"

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_210.html#story]official site[/url]]
